fonte: International Commission of Jurists, Report on the Events in Panama, January 9–12, 1964
texto_para_tela: JANUARY 10, 1963 · DECEMBER 30, 1963 · 17 SITES CHOSEN FOR BOTH FLAGS (ICJ)
nota: Relido no relatório da CIJ: 07/09/1960 (Eisenhower, Shaler Triangle); "since 12 October 12, 1962, at the Bridge of the Americas ... and since the end of that month at the Administration Buildings at Balboa Heights ... and Cristobal"; "on January 10, 1963"; "the Governor selected seventeen spots where both flags were to be displayed"; "taken down by the Governor's orders on December 30, 1963"; escolas: bandeira só dentro. DSB 1964 (relido): "Outdoor flags at schools were among those eliminated". O 17 é da CIJ; o Departamento de Estado, de primeira hora, diz 16 (sin.div-01): na tela, só com o crédito da CIJ.

fontes_adicionais.fonte: Department of State Bulletin, Feb. 3, 1964 ("The Situation in Panama")

divergencia: 17 (CIJ) x 16 (Departamento de Estado) — a voz não diz número; só a tela, opcional.
